segments.en:
My brother and the others...
I hope they're all right.

Don't worry.
Eiji and Rain are
with them, after all.
Yeah...

(Eiji... I'm sure we'll
meet again, won't we?)

rows.notes: [jp]: Fred's brother (Roddy) and the others.

segments.en:
Whoa!
It's really windy out here.
Hyaaaaaaaah!

Whoa!
Hold on a sec!
Hah!!

Phew~ that scared me!
Are you guys training?

Yes. Out here, we can
keep watch at the same time.

Man... without Bro around,
it really feels like
we've lost some muscle.

In the Resistance as it stands,
losing even one person is
enough to shake the whole group.

That's exactly why we must
set out on a journey to find
new people who understand us.

I know that.
Bro left that job to us.

I'm counting on you,
George, Sai Saici.

We ourselves must fill
the hole Domon left.

Now, let's get back
to training!

All right!
Here I come!!
Raaaaaaaaagh!!
Haaaaaah!

Those two are as
incredible as ever...

rows.notes: Sai Saici's [jp] (Domon) rendered "Bro". | [accuracy 5] verb restored: Kanji is asking George and Sai Saici a question | [editorial 12] word order: 'ourselves' dangled at the end of the sentence

segments.en:
Hm? A few people are
gathered over there.
I'll go check it out.

Hey, Kanji.
Are you done with your maintenance?

Yeah... Anyway, what's
everyone gathered here
talking about?
Oh, about the Gundam.

What about
the Gundam?

Domon's Gundam!
You saw it too, didn't you, Kanji?
Oh, that one...

I heard all the Gundams built
in Asia had been sealed away,

but who'd have guessed one
was left in a place like that.

I wonder what that
Gundam's called?

Don't ask me,
I don't know that stuff.
Anybody here know?

Now that you mention it,
Rain said...

Chan, do you
know something?
Well...

Rain used to be
the mechanic for
the God Gundam...
At least, that's what I've heard.

So that thing's
the God Gundam?
Probably...

Maybe she built it
out of spare parts?

Would a machine like that
even have spare parts?
Isn't it the real thing?

Either way,
its fighting power is real.
That's true...

I never thought
there'd be a Gundam
here on Terra.

I knew you'd be
interested, Amuro!

You are too,
aren't you?
Yes, of course!

Domon's Gundam, huh...
I knew it. That guy was
no ordinary martial artist.

rows.notes: seg19: subject restored as Rain (she), the person Chan just named. [jp] -> Terra (not in glossary; form used elsewhere). | [editorial 25] reply to 'I knew you'd be interested' -- 'So are you, right?' mismatched the tense/aux

segments.en:
Dragonar Team here.
We've finished scouting the area!
Let's hear your report.

We're well clear of the enemy
behind us. Looks like no
pursuers for a while.

I wish the enemy'd
just give up after this...

Well, fat chance
of that...

Thanks for scouting!
We're heading to Paradigm City
before the pursuers get here.
You got it!
Head for Paradigm City

rows.notes: [accuracy 3] subject restored: Tapp is voicing his own hope

segments.en:
All ri~ght...
They're in the net.
The Iron Gear?
Yeah, no mistake...

Just so we're clear,
we're bounty hunters.
Not hit men.

I know that.
This bounty's a special one.
We just sink or capture the ship.

Says dead or alive for the crew,
but the pay's a whole lot
better if they're breathing.

In other words!
If we catch the whole lot,
we strike it rich, right?

But can we really pull it off?
That's a battleship.

Isn't that the ship that's been
going toe-to-toe with Grados?

The plan's just like I told you.
Stick to it and it'll work!

Ed!
Is the setup ready?

Hmmm~
Waaait a sec~

Ed!
If they get away,
it's all for nothing!
No proble~m

Lookie, lookie~ Mr. Horla~!
Accessing the Iron Gear~

A Breaker's
Land Ship, huh...
Let's wait and see for now.

Hey!!
There's a Land Ship nearby!

We're close to the city.
It's no surprise if a hauler's
ship is around.
That's Horla's ship!!
What did you say?!
Persistent bastard...

He's been wagging his tail
for Grados. Probably wants
to score some points, huh?

But...
if Horla means to keep
working as a hauler,

he won't want to cause
trouble near Paradigm City.

Keep moving forward!
Don't you dare open fire!

Tch!
Just strolling right along
like they own the place...

They'd be a lot cuter
if they got a little rattled.

Hey, could it be they're
not takin' us seriously...?

They know they've got us
over a barrel. If they'd just
panic and make a move...
This is so frustratin', boss!

Why don't we just
shell 'em and sink 'em~!

Shut up,
Geraba!!

Mess with that city and
we're in deep trouble!!
Can't you figure that out?!
So you're backin' off?

Like hell I am!
But... let's work out
a better plan first.
So you're runnin' away after all!

Why, you!
I'm the one in charge here!!
Take this!!
Gwah!!
Why you...

Raise a hand to me and you're fired!
That what you want?!
Gweh!!

Hmph! We're heading
into Paradigm City too!

Believe it or not, I've got
pull in the City.
I'll handle this just fine...!

Still no fireworks,
huh...
Just staring each other down...

Yaaawn...
How long are we gonna sit here?
If we're doing this, let's go.

Sorry for the wait~!
All set to go!

Good job, Ed.
Go ahead and start.
Oka~y!

Hm?
Something's coming!

Grados?!
Light!
What do the D-3's sensors show?!
Wh-What the hell is this?!
What is it?!

No way?!
We're being hacked!!

Whoa!
Mine too!!
It can't be...

Impossible!
The Gundam won't move!!

This is bad!!
A hacker's gotten into
all our systems!

Almost none of our
computer-controlled machines
work anymore!!

Unbelievable...!
We can't move our machines!

rows.notes: seg14: Ed puns [jp] ("look") on [jp] (Horla); unclear whether Ed is greeting Horla or saying the access goes via Horla's ship -- kept as a playful aside. seg30: Geraba's [jp] (to Horla) rendered "boss". | [editorial 53] ungrammatical 'What's the D-3's sensor show' | [proofread 0] style sheet: 'All right' (not 'Alright'); matches 7.14 'All ri~ght!'

segments.en:
The machines don't work?
What's going on?!

Then we'll just have to
track it by eye!

Here it comes!
It's flying super low!!

It looks to be about
the size of a fighter plane.
Aim by sight and shoot it down!

...No good!
The turrets won't turn either!

The Walker Machines
have machine guns, don't they!

I don't care what it is!
Use anything that fires
bullets and bring it down!

Screw it, here goes nothing!
Fire! Fiiire!!

I'm not gonna kill you.
That'd blow the bounty.
Kyaaaah!!

All right!
Don't move.

Try anything funny and I'll put
one of those right into
your bridge.

Tch! The red one's
right on top of us...

Faye!
Hurry up and take the bridge.
I know!

It's Ed~!
Nice to meetcha~!

What the heck
is this kid... (sweat)
What a filthy bridge.
Mind your own business!

Besides, you people aren't
with Grados, are you?!

What do you think you'll
get out of doing this?
Heh...

I get it!
You're bounty hunters!

So?
What about it?

Okay, okay,
be good and come quietly.

We're taking you to the
Paradigm Military Police.

You seriously think a handful
of people like you can
take this ship?
Eheheh!

Ed and the Iron Gear
are frie~nds!

Iron Gear,
transfoooorm~!

Wh-Whoa...
What the--?

Ed!
Don't do anything extra!
Stop it right now!
Oka~y!

Phew~ I can hardly
believe it myself, but

Ed here can control every
ship and machine you've got.

Fact is, you can't
lift a finger, can you?
Grrr...
The ship's started moving...!

Is this okay?
The bridge has been taken over!

Course it's not okay...
Time for a recapture op!

Not now.
At any rate, this way
we can get into the city.

It's all right.
I don't get a bad feeling.

Is that your
Newtype intuition talking?

Come to think of it,
where's Light?

Oh, he went into his
cockpit looking all gloomy.

Having the D-3's security
cracked must've been
a real shock to him.

Things'll get busy from here.
Let's do what we can now.
You're right.

rows.notes: seg1: [jp] (Ed) -> "this kid", no gender. | [editorial 30] 'protection' unclear for [jp] (system security), per accuracy flag

segments.en:
Looks like we can walk
around the ship freely,

but the bridge is the one
place we can't get into, huh...

Hm?
There's a notice posted
at the bridge entrance.
What does it say?

Knock on the door and I'll
flip the Iron Gear over! <Ed>

What should I do...
Go into the bridge,
or...

Walk away
Knock on the door

No... Without anything to go on,
I'd better not do
anything rash...

Kanji,
what are you doing?
Whoa! Amuro!

Right now, it doesn't matter how.
All that counts is getting
into port at Paradigm City.
You're right.

A sign like this?
It's a bluff.
All ri~ght!
Kanji, what are you doing?!

Don't go getting
any bright ideas.
Y-Yeah...
Inside the bridge...

Elchi, I did a little
checking up on you.

Your father was pretty
well known as a hauler.

And I hear you're
good at throwing knives...
Heh...

But I'm not too shabby
at a quick draw myself.

Got it? Then drop
your weapons on the floor!

Ooh, scary...
Guess it's hands up for us.

Grr...
This is so humiliating~!!
There, good girl.

rows.notes: seg7 is a two-option choice (one option per line). seg8-12 follow "Walk away", seg13-17 follow "Knock". seg4: [jp] signature kept as <Ed>. | [proofread 15] punctuation: question ends '?!' (editorial flag; matches 10.53)

segments.en:
Hm?
Quess, what are you doing?

Heh heh!
I found something good.

With this, we can
talk to the bridge.
Captai~n! Can you hear me~?

What?
Where's that coming from?

Ah, I knew it~!
The bridge has been taken over~!

Quess?
Where are you...

I get it, the speaking tube!
That doesn't use electricity.

That's right!
I'm in the hangar!

Heh~
A speaking tube? How classic.

This ship even
has stuff like that?
So what if it does! Jeez!

Listen,
Elchi~!

If you just do what
those people say, you'll at
least get into the city~!

After that it's the police, so
leave it to that negotiator~!

Right...
Let's trust that he can
figure something out.
Who's this negotiator?
Roger Smith...
Roger Smith?

Oh? You don't know him?
He's the best negotiator
in Paradigm City.

A negotiator?
Oh... that guy...

Hey, you know that
negotiator, Roger,
right?

Yeah...
What about him?

Seems these people
hired Roger for something.
Seriously...?

That's got me curious...
Let me talk to the captain.

Fine.
But don't let your guard down.
I know.

Ed! Bring the Iron Gear
into port at Paradigm City.
Aye aye~!

rows.notes: seg22-28: Faye talking to Spike over comms. [jp] -> speaking tube. | [proofread 30] style sheet: 'Aye aye' (no hyphen)

segments.en:
Pa, pa, para, para,
Paradigm City~ ♪

Pa, pa, para, para,
full speed ahea~d!!

Vrooooom!
Whoooooosh!
Waaaagh!

Noooo~!
The ship's gonna break!

Ed!
Handle it a little more gently!

This is the Bebop.
We've caught a bounty.
Requesting permission to dock.

Hey!
Long time no see, brother.

I hear you caught
yourself a big one?

Big haul this time.
Clear out as much of the
airport as you can for us.

Sure, we'll give you
a grand welcome.
Paradigm City

This is Roger Smith.
Would you mind showing
yourself, Ms. Vega?
The Iron Gear's on schedule.

But at this rate, it'll
fall under the Military
Police's jurisdiction.

Don't worry.
The Iron Gear will be
released soon enough.
How?

By negotiating with the
Military Police's employer.

More importantly, have you
got the money to pay
the cowboys ready?
Yes...
It's all here...

Necessary expenses,
I suppose...
Exactly.
Then I'm counting on you.

Heh...
An unusual client.

Whoa...
It's packed with weird cars out there.

The second we arrive, we get
one hell of a welcome.

What now?
Doesn't look like we can slip out.

Nothing we can do with security
like this... And we can't
move our machines anyway.

Hey!
One of them's coming aboard!

I'm Major Dan Dastun
of the Military Police.
Who's in charge here?!

That would be me.
I'm the captain, Elchi Cargo.
You're Carrying Cargo's daughter?

Yes.
So you know my father.

How could I not?
Every hauler passes
through this city.

But right now,
you people aren't haulers...

We'll have to deal
with you accordingly.

We didn't fight
because we wanted to!

Grados just went and
branded us "wanted"!

I'll hear your side later.
As of now, the Iron Gear is under
Military Police jurisdiction.

A few of your representatives
will come with us to the station.
Fine...

Um...
I represent the non-combatants.
My name is Anna Stephanie.

There are many refugees
aboard this ship.
Will they be protected...?

After questioning, we'll
decide what's to be done
with the Iron Gear.

Until then, stay aboard the ship!
And don't you dare try
anything suspicious.
Yes, sir.
Kanji, Amuro, let's go.
Right...
Want me to come too?
I'm coming too!

Not you two.
Who knows what kind of
blunder you'd make!
What's that supposed to mean!

We're not dealing
with Breakers here.

Come back when you've picked
up a little more culture.
Come on, let's go!
O-Okay!

Hmph!
Look at her, all stuck-up!

Aww...
I wanted to go
into the city too~

Don't be so down.
Keep the Iron Gear safe for us.
Will do!

So this is Military
Police headquarters...

Elchi, drag out the
negotiations as long as you can.

I know!
Let's pray the negotiator can
do something in the meantime.

What are you doing?!
Get in here.
Oh, yes, yes!

...and that's how it went.
Grados kept attacking us,
it's been a real ordeal.

I see...
I more or less understand
the situation.

But however it came about,
the fact is you've ended up
joining the Resistance.

Anyone who aids the Resistance
must be cracked down on.
That is the law of this city.

So what happens
to us?

Once you're disarmed, the whole
crew goes into a detention camp.
Something along those lines.

You won't hand us
over to Grados?

Frankly...
I'd rather not...

But the final call on you
is made by those above me.
I simply follow their orders.

We're fighting
the invaders!
And yet you--!
Stop it... Kanji.

I can understand
how you feel...

But I'll say this much:
it's because you're strong
that you invite conflict.

Our strength
invites battle?

Yes. If you didn't have such
powerful weapons, couldn't you
have stayed haulers?

Even in times like these,
ordinary people are
struggling desperately to live.

To them, war is nothing
but one ego clashing
against another...

If you're allowed
to stay in this city...

and you intend to live quietly
here as ordinary citizens,
I'll do what I can for you.

But if you still aid the
Resistance, I'll send you
straight to a detention camp.
Major Dastun!
What is it!
Urgent message, sir!!

Understood!
I'll be right there.

That Dastun guy doesn't
seem like a bad person.

Felt like I got a lecture
from my old man.

He said urgent message...
Has Roger Smith made his move?
I sure hope so...
Um, Major Dastun?

You're free.
You may go.

Huh?
Really?

At least while you're in this city,
you're no longer wanted.

But why?
What happened?

It's a decision from above.
Even I don't know why.

We're done here.
We're busy too, you know.
Now get out of here.
We'll do just that.

rows.notes: [jp] -> Major (Dastun). [jp] -> Carrying Cargo (not in glossary; form used in library entries). seg7 [jp] -> "cowboys" (bounty hunters). seg9 [jp]: Roger confirming the money.

segments.en:
Well, whatever happened,
we're in the clear.

Don't let your guard down.
Don't forget this city is
allied with Grados.

But why'd they suddenly
set us free?

The negotiator must have
made some kind of move.

I'm sure that's it!
Let's go see
Roger Smith right away.

We've got to
thank him, right?
Yeah...

Hey... Elchi?
Don't tell me you don't
know where Roger lives...

Hahaha!
He's famous, so if we ask
someone around, they'll know.

That's dangerous.
We should keep as low
a profile as we can.

...I know that!
Back on the ship, I've got
the map Rain gave me.

Then let's hurry
and go get it.

Aw, wait a minute.
It's been ages since
I've been to a city.

Wouldn't it be okay to make
a little detour first?

Go see the city
Head straight back to the ship

Eh, why not.
Let's buy some souvenirs
to take back.

Hey, not you too, Kanji!
We're not here to sightsee.

We've been wound tight
this whole time, haven't we?

Why not let Elchi do
what she wants for now?

We don't know what
will happen after this.

Scouting the city while
we have the chance
wouldn't be a bad idea.

It's decided~!
Come on, let's hurry!

No way!
Everyone's waiting on the ship.

Right.
We're not here to
have fun.

Aww~
You're both so mea~n!

rows.notes: seg8 is a two-option choice; seg9-16 follow "Go see the city", seg17-19 follow "Head back".

segments.en:
Hey! Elchi and the others
are back!
Everyone, we're baaack!

Welcome back.
So, how did it go?

Perfect! They said we're not wanted
criminals in this city anymore!

Then we can go shopping
for supplies, right?
Once we've done what needs doing!
Whaaat?!

The guards outside suddenly thinned out,
so the negotiations must have gone well.

We didn't do anything. That Roger guy
probably handled it all for us.

Kanji!
You didn't have to tell them that!

Hahaha!
I figured it'd be something like that!

Anyway!
I'm just glad everyone's safe.

Come to think of it,
what happened to the bounty hunters?

Come to think of it, at some point
our mechs started working again, too.

Jet said~
it was okay to put 'em back now~

Aaah!
One of those bounty hunters!
Hehe~!

Robo-buddies~ sorry for making you~
all stuck earlier~

Now I'll make you mooove
looooads~

Waaah!
Stop! They're fine just the way they are!
Reeeally~~?
Um... and you are?
I'm Ed~~

Say, Ed... where's that
scaaary lady?

Faye~
flew off in her plane~
Don't you have to go back, Ed?

Ed's gonna~ play on the Iron Gear
a little longer~
Oh, is that so...

Ed~dy~!
Wanna play with your big bro?

Uh-huh, okay~
Ed'll play with Light~

You know my name?
Aw, that makes me happy.

'Cause~ you're the D-3's pilot, right~?
Hey~ can I play with the D-3~?

Yeah, sure.
Come on over here!
Yaaaaay~~!

Kind of a weird pair. When it comes to
kids, I'd have figured on Tapp, right?

Hey, hey...
Don't go pinning that label on me.

Well, as far as that Ed kid goes,
Light seems more on the same
wavelength than Tapp.

Ugh~... To think our ship got hijacked
by something like that~

rows.notes: Ed's gender left unstated (speakers.tsv blank): no pronouns used for Ed. [15] [jp] rendered 'one of the bounty hunter pair'. [17] [jp] -> 'Robo-buddies'. | [editorial 9] stiff 'Don't go saying unnecessary things' for Elchi's casual scolding | [editorial 15] awkward 'One of the bounty hunter pair' for [jp]

segments.en:
Kanji,
we're heading out soon.
Yeah, I'm all set.

Heeey!
Captain Elchi!
What is it?

A woman's come to see you. Says she's
Roger Smith's messenger.
Roger's?

?!
What's this?

Oh, this person says she's
Roger's messenger.

R. Dorothy Wayneright. I'm supposed
to be Roger Smith's secretary.

You must be the captain,
Elchi Cargo.

Yes. We were just about to call on
Roger at his home.
Roger is out at the moment.

I see... I'd like to meet Roger.
What should we do?

He said that once his business is done,
he'll come straight here.

So we just have to wait here on the
Iron Gear, right?
That's right.
She sure doesn't say much...

She doesn't move a muscle, either.
Kinda creepy...

Oh? I think she's cute.
That black dress really suits you.

Black clothes are Roger's policy.
He has the worst taste.
Ahahaha... (sweat)
Stupid!
Oh, so that's how it is...
Stop it! Both of you!
Well then, I'll see you later.

Something's odd about her...
Though I don't get a bad feeling
from her...
Don't sweat the little things!

To everyone else,
you're pretty odd too, Amuro.

Haha...
You're right. Sorry.

Roger says he'll come to us, so let's get
back to work. We've got loads to do!
Now, what should I do...

rows.notes: [22] [jp] -> 'He has the worst taste' (Roger is male). [24]-[26]: target of Quess's [jp] unstated; kept untargeted. 'Both of you' = Quess and Chan (or Dorothy) -- kept as in JP. [23] [jp] kept as '(sweat)'.

segments.en:
Seeing the downtown like this, it doesn't
feel like the place is under Grados rule...

I wonder why Grados allows
this one city to govern itself...
Paradigm Corporation: President's Office

So, how did it go,
Roger Smith?

(This man is the head of the Paradigm
Corporation, Alex Rosewater.)

(Not someone I care to meet, but if I'm
to succeed at this job, there's no
helping it...)

Thanks to you,
the worst was avoided.

No, without your information,
I'd have made the wrong call myself.

I'd like you to keep mediating
all sorts of matters for me.
Mediating?

The fact is, there's something I'd like
you to deliver to the Iron Gear.
What is this?
They'll understand once you hand it over.

Ah...
It's nothing dangerous.

It's not the sort of thing that
explodes or harms anyone's health.

I am a negotiator. I have no intention
of getting involved in murky dealings.

My job is to send the Iron Gear on
its way to Asia without incident.

Hmm... But you see...
Paradigm City is allied with Grados.

I'd think this affair will make
all kinds of political waves.

I believe I've made the greatest possible
concession on this matter. I'd like you
to at least know that much.
Then what would you have me do?

I have no intention of
holding you to account.

It's just that as long as the Iron Gear
is in this city, you can't really
turn this job down, can you?
Is this a penalty?
Nothing of the sort.

In my position, I can't go near
the Iron Gear.
That's why I'm asking you.

Naturally, I'll have ample payment
ready for you as well.

...Understood.
I'll take charge of it.

Make sure it gets to them.
By whatever means it takes.
(I decided to accept Alex's request.)

(Because I sensed that prying any further
would put me in danger.)

I didn't expect you to be waiting
for me, Dorothy.

If you take the subway, it doesn't
take all that long.
Good grief...
You're going to the Iron Gear, aren't you?

That's right.
Did you deliver my message?
Yes, no problem.
Splendid!

He certainly does seem to be
an excellent negotiator...

Colonel Char,
was this to your satisfaction?

Yes... I'm grateful for
your consideration in this matter.

Neo Zeon promises its friendship
to the Paradigm Corporation.

I'm counting on you.
It's for our mutual benefit, after all.
Then I'll take my leave for today...

(Amuro... I'm doing something
underhanded.)

(If you're nearby,
then try to sense me...!)

rows.notes: [2] narration location label. [12] [jp]: subject read as the Iron Gear crew ('They'll understand once you hand it over'). [29] [jp] read as Alex telling Roger to use any means. Roger's indented thought lines (full-width space) not reproduced. | [editorial 1] consistency: bare 'Grados' as in unit 00 and the corpus majority | [editorial 17] consistency: matches Amuro's 'allied with Grados' (11.1) | [proofread 2] location card in UI form 'Place: Room'

segments.en: Looks like Roger's here.
I'll head to the bridge.
So you're Roger Smith.

That's right. If you don't mind,
I'll get straight to the point.
Sure, go ahead.

Listen. For the Iron Gear to pass
through this city, there's a condition.
A condition?

What?
You still need more money?

No... not that. I just need you to
play the villain a little.
The villain...?

The story will be that you got through
here by threatening to destroy the city.
...That's all.

What?! No way!
That'd make us just like...

The city's owner values his diplomatic
relations with Grados.

That's how this city keeps its peace,
so there's no helping it.
Or do you have some other way?

In this case, we'll simply have to
accept a temporary disgrace.

They've already gone along with a lot of
unreasonable requests from us.

If we reach Asia safely,
GEAR will take us in.
I suppose so...

It's purely a diplomatic measure.
Nothing you need to worry about.

You can go into town, and as long as
you pay, you can get supplies too.

Hehh~
Now that's handy.

Next, let's go over the arrangements
for leaving the city.
...And those are the arrangements.
Is everything clear?

Yes...
Thank you for everything.
That is my job, after all.

Oh, and one more thing. I've been
entrusted with something from
this city's owner.
That suitcase?

Ah!!
This is...!
A Psycho-Frame!
A Psycho-Frame?

It's a part that helps when you're
controlling things like Funnels.

The Gundam has the same thing
built into it, too.
I'll examine it right away.
I'm counting on you, Chan.

Yes!
Leave it to me!

Roger, did they tell you
anything about this frame?

No... The head of the Paradigm
Corporation just told me to hand it over.
I have no idea at all what it is.
I see...

In any case, that's the last of
my business. I'll be going.

Okay, everyone, back to work, please.
We depart as soon as we're ready.
Got it!

(A Psycho-Frame...
Why would something like that...)
This feeling...!
I... have to go.
There's still time before we depart...

rows.notes: [1] blank speaker read as Kanji continuing. [12] Alex (the city's owner, male) -> 'his'. [16] [jp]: 'They've already granted us quite a lot' (Roger/the city). [17] [jp] -> GEAR. | [accuracy 16] [jp]: 'unreasonable requests' restored (was 'granted us quite a lot') | [editorial 12] consistency: bare 'Grados'

segments.en:
There's still time before we depart.
I'll head into town while I can.
Are you going into town?
Yeah.

Watch yourself. This city's got plenty
of drifters and thugs too.

Some of 'em are even bounty hunters
like the ones earlier.

Outsiders like you lot shouldn't go
walking around alone.

Is that because Grados showed up,
after all?

Not really. This place has always
been like that.

I mean, it's got something as nasty
as the Military Police.

If you like, how about we go into town
together? I'll show you around!

Yeah?
Then I'll take you up on it.

rows.notes: [accuracy 1] subject and verb restored: Rag is asking Kanji | [editorial 6] consistency: bare 'Grados'

segments.en: Inside the Dome sure is pretty~!

It's a whole different world
from outside.

Let's go over there!
A new shop's opened!

Heeey!
Don't leave me behind!
That young man just now...

That feeling...
Is he a Londo Bell pilot?

So others besides Amuro
have come to Terra too...

Long time no see,
Colonel!

Wha... Quess!
Is that you?!

I'm surprised. I never thought
I'd run into you in a place like this.
Were you aboard the Iron Gear?
Yeah... that's right.

Hey! You want to go back to space,
don't you, Colonel?
I'll take you there!

Quess...!
How do you know that...

Hee hee hee! Because that's why you sent
the Psycho-Frame in, isn't it, Colonel?

Yes... But I never imagined
you'd be the one to come.

Heh heh!
Did you think Amuro would come?
Phew~...

Hm?
What's wrong?

Ah, I'll rest here for a bit,
so take your time looking around.

Thanks, then.
Don't mind if I do.

Rag sure is...
a powerhouse...

Phew~
My legs feel like lead...
Is it this late already...

Uh-oh... I'd better get back
to the Iron Gear soon...

Hm?
Hey! Quess!

Whoa!! What?!
Kanji, you were there?

(What's with her?
She's more flustered than usual...)

You...
what did you come here for?

How rude!
I'm just shopping!

And what about you? Why are you
sneaking around like that?!

Wandering out here all alone...
You know, we're--

Shut up!
I'm going back right now!!

Ah!
Hey! Wait!!
Whoa!!

Ow ow ow...
My legs got all tangled up.

Ahahaha! What're you doing,
Kanji? How pathetic!

Quess was walking around alone.
Then she ran off.

Quess was?
So that's what happened.

Then we'd better go after her right away.
It'd be bad if something happened.
Right.

I'm pretty sure she said she was going
back to the ship...

rows.notes: [6] Char's guess about Kanji. [13] [jp] -> 'space'. [33] [jp] -> 'sneaking around like that' (hiding his presence). [34] Kanji's lecture trails off; kept unfinished. | [accuracy 6] subject/verb restored: Char wondering about Kanji | [accuracy 18] subject restored: Quess asking Char | [editorial 22] 'Then I won't hold back' misfit for Rag accepting Kanji's offer to go on shopping

segments.en:
Blume,
the repairs are done.
Let's see...

Well, well...
You did it right.

You're quick, too.
Not bad at all.
That's because Fred's been helping me.

When there's fighting, the older guys
work hard for us.
So now it's our turn to work hard!

Oh!
Well said!

Then I'm counting on you
for this one too!

Yeah!
Leave it to me!
They're still repairing the Iron Gear...

They've been at it nonstop
ever since we got here...

Oh!
Kanji.

Blume,
did Quess come back?

She got back a little while ago. She's
probably doing maintenance on her mech
or something.

Phew... I see.
Then that's fine.

Looks rough.
Want us to help with anything?

This is our job. You main pilots
just rest.

Well, well~ So you can say
things like that now, huh~
Sh-Shut up!

The unsung heroes, huh...
We should be grateful to them.

The ship with our bounty is right
in front of us, and yet...

So what's going to happen to
our bounty money?

Getting outmaneuvered by a negotiator...
We're such idiots...

If it weren't for the Resistance mess,
riding the Iron Gear wouldn't be
half bad...

Come to think of it,
where'd those two go?!
Well, not my problem...

Hm? Somebody's working on something
over there.

I'll go take a look.
Maybe I can help out.

What are you up to?
Um, it was Ed, right?

Uh, well~ I'm making the ship's
security reeeally strong~

Hey! Ed,
do this block too, would ya?
Aye aye~

Huh~ I don't really get it,
but that's amazing...

Yes yes~
Incoming call from the Bebop~

You! How long are you planning
to hang around there?

Get back here now!
Or I'll leave you behind!!

It's still okay~
Spike and~ Jet are~
out and about~~

I know that! Do you know where
those two went?

Mmm!
Roger's house~
What? That's the negotiator's place.

What'd those two go there for,
now of all times...
Dunnooo~

Hmm... If they went to bust the place up,
that'd be fun...

Anyway, you wrap things up
and come back, too!
I can't go out otherwise!
Okaaay~!

Whoaaa!
H-Hey, Ed! Wait up!

Hey, you!
What are you making Ed do?
Well, uh, just a little...

Well, whatever. But you're paying
a fee for using Ed!
Of course!

C'mon...
help me out, Kanji...
O-Okay, fine...

Um, Faye! I'll handle the fee.
Let us look after Ed for a while.
Fine.

Also, could somebody run over
to the negotiator's place for me?

I need you to bring our ship's crew
back here.

Kanji! Go to Roger's house and bring
her partners back.

Huh?
I have to go?

I'm at a crucial point right now.
Please!!

Thanks a bunch.
Bye!
Ah... Faye!

Sigh... Can't be helped.
Guess I'm the one who has to go...

rows.notes: [5] [jp] -> 'the older guys' (the pilots). [21]-[26] Faye's monologue; [25] 'those two' = Spike and Jet. [jp]: honorific dropped ('Faye'). [58] [jp] -> 'her partners' (Faye, female). | [editorial 24] consistency: 'Resistance' capitalised as elsewhere in these units | [editorial 28] 'Let's go see' / 'I can help' mixed we/I; Kanji goes alone to Ed (19.29) | [editorial 32] consistency: Ed's [jp] is 'Aye-aye~!' in 8.30 | [proofread 32] style sheet: 'Aye aye' (no hyphen)

segments.en:
You're a member of the Iron Gear,
aren't you?

Yes, that's right.
What about it?

I've been watching you for a while...
Don't go wandering around on your own.

It'd be a real headache if you people
got mixed up in some incident.

Get back to your ship before
there's any trouble.

I'd like to, but I don't know where
Roger Smith's house is...
Roger the negotiator?
Ah, yeah, that's him!

Hrrm... No choice, then!
I'll take you there, so follow me!

Haha...
Thanks a lot.
Hmph!

We're here.
This is the building.
Wh-Whoa, it's huge!

I have work to do, so I'll leave you
here. Have Roger take you back.
Ah, uh, sure...

Listen, whatever you do,
don't cause any trouble.

Okay, first things first,
ring the doorbell...
Yes, what is it?
Oh, you're...
What is your business?

Ah... I think a couple of guys called
Spike and Jet are here.

Yes...
Roger is seeing them now.
Is it something urgent?

Yeah...
I came to fetch them.

Could you tell them I've come
on Faye's behalf?
Understood.
Roger's Mansion: Reception Room

Looks like nothing's changed
with you, Roger.

And you two still seem to be
in the bounty hunting business.

Pretty much... But it's gotten a bit
harder since Grados showed up.

By the way, Roger, didn't you take a job
from someone with a bounty recently?

You mean the Iron Gear? Even if I had
taken a job, I couldn't give you any
information.
We know that.

But a bounty we caught
dropped your name.

Roger, I'm not looking
to steal your job...

But if you took the job,
there's gotta be a story behind it, right?

...If you knew that, you couldn't go on
being cowboys come tomorrow.
I've pretty much figured it out already...

Spike... Jet...
I'm telling you for your own good.

You'd do better not to get
too deeply involved in this.

The reward you were supposed
to receive is ready for you here.
So that's why you called us here.

I see. You used us to get the Iron Gear
into port, didn't you?

I'm sorry... Won't you just back off
without asking any questions?

Well, we sure got dragged into
one heck of a farce.

But... Roger, you do realize, right?
One wrong move and there's no
turning back.

Yes...
Honestly, I had my doubts too.

Whatever the circumstances, it doesn't
change the fact that I got involved
with the Resistance...

But I am a negotiator.
I'll find a way.
But you two are different.
I see...

Well, we got what we came for.
Let's clear out, Spike.

Jet, I've got something to talk
to Roger about. Go on ahead.

Hm...? Hey...
You're not seriously...!

Roger...
I owe you one, after all.

You've repaid that debt plenty with
this business. Don't worry about it.

That ain't all. There are folks
I don't like either, y'know...

Cut it out, Spike.
Nothing good'll come of it.

If you don't like it, bow out here.
I'll do it on my own.

I've had enough of getting dragged into
messy business. I'm getting out.
I'll talk to Spike myself.

Once that guy starts something,
he won't listen. See ya...

Jet, is the usual place
all right for the money?

Yeah...
And take his share out of it.
Understood...

Spike...
What do you intend to do now?

I'm already on board.
I'll help you with your job.

In your position, it's gotta be
hard to make a move, right?

I see...
Then I'll sign a contract with you.

Though I hope it never comes to
a situation where I need your help...

So... how much does it take
to hire you?

Let's see...
Just cover my meals for now.

Heh...
That's easily arranged.

They're taking a while...
Are they still talking?

Sorry to keep you waiting. Jet will be
right out. The other one says he's
staying for a while.
Oh, okay...

Hm? You're...
from the Iron Gear, if I recall...

Kanji Akatsuki.
You're Jet, I take it?
Yeah...

Faye's sick of waiting
for you guys.

I see... Don't know why you're the one
coming to pick me up, though...

That's what
I'd like to know.

Also, I'm supposed to bring back
this Spike guy too.

He's not coming back
to our ship anymore.
Huh?

Looks like I put you to some trouble.
I'll give you a lift to the airport.

That's a big help, but... Spike's your
partner, isn't he? You're okay with this?

...You getting in or not?
Dawdle and I'll leave you behind!

Yeah, I'm getting in!
Hang on a sec!

rows.notes: [0] narration location label ([jp]). [4]/[7] [jp] -> 'someone with a bounty' / 'a bounty'. [10] [jp] kept as 'cowboys' (Bebop slang for bounty hunters). [41] [jp] -> 'I'm already on board'. [50] [jp] = Spike (male) -> 'he'. [55] [jp]: 'for you guys' added for natural English (Faye was waiting for both). | [accuracy 49] subject restored: Kanji means Roger and the bounty hunters | [editorial 3] consistency: bare 'Grados' | [editorial 21] consistency: 'Resistance' capitalised | [editorial 46] awkward 'Enough for meals for now'll do' | [editorial 57] Japanese idiom 'That's my line' replaced with natural English for [jp] | [proofread 0] location card in UI form 'Place: Room'

segments.en:
See ya, Kanji!
Here's hoping you have a safe voyage.
Thanks!

That was quick.
Did you finish your errand?

Yeah.
I came back by plane.

Hey~ hey~
Where're Spike and Jet~?

Ed! It's about time you went back
to your own ship!

Okaaay~
See ya later~
Whoooooooosh~!

Maybe I should've told Ed that
Spike didn't come back...

Oh well.
Ed'll find out back on the ship...

Phew...
Now we can finally set sail.

Don't you go out again either.
We're departing soon.
Yeah, got it.
"Depart" is now available.

rows.notes: [9]-[10] Ed's gender unknown: phrased without pronouns. [14] UI term [jp] -> "Depart".

segments.en:
At last, we're setting out
for the Asia Continent.

Once we get to Asia, we won't be
wanted criminals anymore, right?
Here's hoping!

We're still inside enemy territory.
There's no telling what might happen.

Right...
Let's not let our guard down.
Iron Gear, move out!!

Heh heh heh... The Iron Gear bunch
are moving out right on schedule.

rows.notes: Speaker Horla: gender blank in speakers.tsv, no pronouns needed.

segments.en:
Geraba!
How'd it go?!

Took a lotta work, y'know.
They're nothin' but a bunch of dimwits.

But hey, is a setup like that
really gonna cut it?

Doesn't matter! There's nothing but the
Sea of Clouds on either side anyway.
They've got nowhere to run!

All right!
Let's do this!!

Damn!
An ambush!

This is bad. The land's too narrow
around here to go around them!
Then we've just gotta fight!!

<Win Condition>
Repel the enemy mothership within
the time limit

rows.notes: [1] [jp] (Geraba's helpers) -> 'a bunch of dimwits'. [2] [jp] = the trap (mines, row 28). | [proofread 0] punctuation: question mark missing on a question

segments.en:
We've taken out most of
the enemy's first line!

All riiight!
Let's charge straight in!

Wait! We can't go in scattered like this.
Let's regroup first!
Kanji's right!

The Iron Gear will keep advancing!
All units, gather around it!

Horla!!
I'm forcing my way through!

Heh...
Not so fast!

Geraba!
Set off the mines!
You got it!!
Waaaaaaah!

Tch!
It's a minefield!

Fall back!
Fall baaack!!

That's dirty, Horla!
You droopy-eyed creep!!

My eyes aren't droopy! Shut up,
you lousy dumpling!!
What was thaaat?!!

Get as mad as you want, your eyes
are still droopy!!
Whaaat!!
They're here!!

Beck, is it?
All riiight!
Yeeee-haaaw!

Good timing. Now we can hit them
from the front and the back!

Well then,
let's get this started!

Ready the long-range guns!!
Make 'em dance in the blast!
Aaaaaaah!

Heh heh heh heh! Gotta put
my products to good use!

Terminator Police,
activate!

Ku ku ku... You can't escape in this
narrow corridor! How long can you
hold out, I wonder?

Here they come! A huge enemy force
coming in from the rear!!

Light! How many of them
are there?

No idea!
There's a whole lot of 'em!

They've got us pinned
front and back...!

There's a crazy number of 'em
in the vanguard alone...

No whining! Just do
whatever you can!

<Win Condition>
Repel Horla's mothership,
the Govarie

rows.notes: [7]-[10] insults: [jp] 'droopy-eyed', [jp] 'lousy dumpling'. [19] [jp] = Beck's manufactured machines -> 'my products'. [28] [jp] -> Govarie (glossary Govarie-class). | [accuracy 24] verb restored: 'There's a whole lot' (was fragment 'A whole lot!') | [editorial 26] awkward 'Their vanguard alone is a crazy number' | [proofread 9] punctuation: question mark missing ('?!!' doubled form)

segments.en:
These guys are hanging on better than
I figured. No wonder Grados put
a bounty on 'em.

Hey, Horla! Isn't it about time
we told 'em to surrender?

...Let's do that. The more spoils
the better, after all.

We'll halt our attack
for now as well!

Dammit!
Like I'm gonna lose!

Stop shooting.
The enemy's ceased fire.
Huh? Why?

Anyway, everyone, go back and
resupply while you can!

rows.notes: [1] [jp] -> 'Hey, Horla!' (honorific dropped). | [editorial 0] consistency: bare 'Grados' as in the other units

segments.en:
The enemy's regrouping.
Next time they'll come all at once.

They're going to demand our surrender.
Elchi, a transmission's coming in.
It's Horla!!

Long time no see,
Elchi Cargo.
I knew it, Horla!

So you were behind all these attacks!
What's the big idea?!

Seems you still haven't outgrown
being a pampered young lady,
Miss Elchi Cargo.

I don't know what's going on
behind that pretty face, but

one thing's for certain:
your life is in my hands.
I suppose so......

And that's not all.
I've been reborn!

With a single whim of mine, young lady...
you could die this very instant!

What do you want me to do,
Horla...?

Just... become my... wife...
Ehehehe...
No way!!
Young lady!

No!
Noooo way!!

Young lady!
Don't you value your life?!

Hmph!!
No means nooo!

Make me really angry, and the
Iron Gear, and you along with it...!

Hey! Boss!
Somethin' weird's comin' up from behind!

Shut up!
This is the crucial part!

But... that thing's
probably an enemy!
What do you mean, probably?!

What is that?
It's just one unit!
Surround it and crush it!
Here they come, Ginga!!

All right!
Let's do it!
Command Install!
Whoa-hot-hot-hot!!

What the heck
is that thing?!!

This is bad, Boss!!
That just took out half of us!

Wh-
Whaaat!!

What's going on?!
That explosion just now...

The enemy's in chaos!
Isn't this our chance?

All units, charge!!
Ignore the enemies behind us!

rows.notes: [7]-[8] one sentence split across pages, cut at the same point. [11] Horla's gender is blank in speakers.tsv, so [jp] -> 'I've been reborn!' (no gendered wording).[20] threat trails off as in JP. [jp] -> 'young lady'. [28] [jp] -> 'Command Install' (not in glossary). | [accuracy 26] [jp]: Horla's units are closing in to surround Dendoh ([25]); 'Here we go' lost the meaning | [proofread 24] punctuation: question mark missing | [proofread 30] punctuation: question mark missing ('?!!' doubled form)

segments.en:
Looks like the Iron Gear's on the move.
Let's go back 'em up too!

We can't.
Dendoh's out of energy.

Yeah, but if they get wiped out
in the meantime, what's the point!

It's all right!
The Iron Gear will hold out.
Ms. Vega?!

Hokuto! Ginga!
Don't panic.

There are a lot of enemies. Swap out
the Hyper Dendoh Batteries now,
while you can!

Elise!
Are you ready?

The batteries are ready.
Pull Dendoh back for now!

Got it!
Hokuto! We're heading back!
Right!

Elise!
We're counting on you.

Leave it to me!
I'll have it done in record time!

rows.notes: [jp] / [jp] / [jp]: honorifics dropped. | [editorial 4] project decision: [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' (Ginga, Roger, Hokuto elsewhere)

segments.en:
Why?!
How do they have that much power?!!

That's payback for earlier!
Main cannon! Fiiire!!
Waaaaaaaah!

Boss!
Time to call it quits!

Shut up! We hold out
until Beck's unit catches up!

Ms. Vega!
How's the battle going?!

We have the upper hand!
The Iron Gear is pushing them back.
Looks like we made it in time...

Hokuto! One more
Final Attack!
Yeah!

Here goes!
Unicorn!
Gwaaah!

Boss!
We can't hold out any longer!

Argh! I hate to say a line like this,
but... we retreat for now!!

So that's the power of the
Data Weapons I've heard about.

Sorry, Horla, but that was
quite a show.
Pull back all units.
A wise man stays clear of danger!

Looks like the enemies coming from
behind are pulling out.

Phew...
That was a close one...

Yeah. If that backup hadn't shown up,
who knows what would've happened...

It was that machine, wasn't it...
The one that backed us up.
Is it GEAR?

Probably...
I'd say that machine is one of
GEAR's weapons.

Hey, can't we get in contact
with them?
I'm relaying it now.

Oh!
Here it comes.

Crew of the Iron Gear,
can you hear me?

We are GEAR,
the Asian defense organization.

We welcome the Iron Gear's arrival
from the bottom of our hearts.

You really saved us.
That was a close call.

We share a common enemy...
Let us go forward hand in hand.
Yes, gladly!

rows.notes: [jp] -> GEAR (quote marks dropped). [10] [jp] -> 'Unicorn' (Data Weapon; library has 'Unicorn Drill'). [8] [jp] -> 'Final Attack' (library: Gambar/Ganbar Final Attack -- inconsistent there). | [accuracy 25] subject restored: Light (D-3) is relaying GEAR's transmission | [editorial 5] project decision: [jp] = 'Ms. Vega' | [proofread 0] punctuation: question marks missing on two questions

segments.en:
So Dendoh and the Iron Gear
have finally joined hands.

To think they could win a battle
despite such a gap in strength...

It's been a long time since I've
watched such an entertaining fight.

Is this, too, a feat made possible
by the power of Dendoh's
Data Weapons...?

But that power befits none but
Emperor Galfa, ruler of the
entire universe.

Dendoh... One day, I shall claim
every last one of your Data Weapons.
